headline.title: Ferrari is using IBM’s AI to create F1 superfans
headline.summary: Ferrari is collaborating with IBM to enhance the Formula 1 fan experience through the use of artificial intelligence. The partnership aims to create more engaging and personalized interactions for superfans of Scuderia Ferrari.

articles.title: Elon Musk has given up on solar power (on Earth)
articles.summary: Elon Musk's xAI has shifted its focus from solar power to natural gas, while SpaceX is concentrating on developing orbital data centers. This change raises questions about the future of Musk's vision for a solar-electric economy.

articles.title: Google’s new anything-to-anything AI model is wild
articles.summary: Google has introduced a new AI model capable of generating content across various formats, referred to as "anything-to-anything." This model aims to enhance creative possibilities in digital content creation, as demonstrated by user experiments like deepfaking a child's stuffed animal in vacation scenarios.

articles.title: Catch up on the Dialogues stage at Google I/O 2026.
articles.summary: At Google I/O 2026, Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai participated in a discussion on the Dialogues stage, addressing key topics related to the company's vision and future developments. The event highlighted Google's ongoing commitment to innovation and technology advancements.

articles.title: AOP-Wiki EMOD 3.0: Data Model Expansions and Content Evaluation Framework for Using Agentic AI to Improve Integration between AOPs and New Approach Methodologies (NAMs)
articles.summary: The AOP-Wiki EMOD 3.0 introduces a data model expansion and a content evaluation framework aimed at enhancing the integration of Adverse Outcome Pathways (AOPs) with new approach methodologies (NAMs) in chemical regulation. This update emphasizes the use of agentic AI to improve the contextualization of in vitro and in silico methods as alternatives to animal testing.

articles.title: Trace2Skill: Verifier-Guided Skill Evolution for Long-Context EDA Agents
articles.summary: The article introduces Trace2Skill, a framework designed to enhance hardware LLM agents' performance on Complex Verilog Design Problems (CVDP) by utilizing verifier-guided skill evolution without requiring RTL-specialized model fine-tuning. This approach addresses challenges related to localizing relevant RTL components and managing dependencies within large repository snapshots.

articles.title: S2ED: From Story to Executable Descriptions for Consistency-Aware Story Illustration
articles.summary: The article introduces S2ED (Story-to-Executable Descriptions), a framework designed to enhance multi-frame story illustration by converting narratives into editable executable descriptions, ensuring consistency in character identity and layout across frames. This model-agnostic approach aims to improve coherence in long-horizon storytelling without the need for extensive training.

articles.title: Search-E1: Self-Distillation Drives Self-Evolution in Search-Augmented Reasoning
articles.summary: The article discusses a new approach called Search-E1, which utilizes self-distillation to enhance the capabilities of search-augmented reasoning agents after their initial training. This method aims to improve performance by integrating external supervision and additional modules, while also restructuring the search process.

articles.title: Gated DeltaNet-2: Decoupling Erase and Write in Linear Attention
articles.summary: The article introduces Gated DeltaNet-2, a model that enhances linear attention by decoupling the processes of erasing and writing in a fixed-size recurrent state. This approach aims to improve memory editing in attention mechanisms while maintaining efficient time and memory usage.

articles.title: CR4T: Rewrite-Based Guardrails for Adolescent LLM Safety
articles.summary: The article discusses CR4T, a framework designed to enhance the safety of large language models (LLMs) in adolescent digital environments by implementing rewrite-based guardrails. This approach aims to provide constructive guidance rather than relying solely on refusal-oriented suppression, addressing the limitations of current safety mechanisms that are primarily focused on adult norms.

articles.title: Virtual 3D H&E Staining from Phase-contrast Back-illumination Interference Tomography
articles.summary: Researchers have developed a method to create virtual 3D H&E stained images from unprocessed tissues using Back-illumination Interference Tomography (BIT), a novel phase microscopy technology. This advancement allows for rapid, non-destructive volumetric imaging, potentially enhancing disease management through improved tissue microarchitecture assessment.

articles.title: Echo4DIR: 4D Implicit Heart Reconstruction from 2D Echocardiography Videos
articles.summary: Researchers have developed Echo4DIR, a framework for reconstructing 4D cardiac geometry from 2D echocardiography videos, addressing challenges related to geometric ambiguity and temporal discontinuity. The approach utilizes statistical shape models and a cardiac conditional signed distance function to enhance the accuracy of the 3D shape reconstruction.
